newsitem.title: THAILAND: Hoechst in Thai packaging film venture.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst in Thai packaging film venture.

text.p: Thai Petrochemical Industry Plc and Hoechst Trespaphan GmbH on Tuesday signed a joint venture agreement for production of packaging film for the Thai market.
TPI president Pramuan Leophairatana told a news conference that Hoechst Trespaphan, a Hoechst AG unit, holds a 51 percent stake in the venture, Thai Trespaphan Co Ltd, with TPI owning the rest.
Andreas Grein, Hoechst Trespaphan's management board chairman, said the venture will initially invest about 100 million marks in the plant which will start production by end-1998.
The plant in eastern Rayong province will initially produce 25,000 tonnes annually of trespaphan films used widely in the cigarette and food packaging industries, he said.
Grein said Thai Trespaphan plans to invest another 100 million marks later to double its production capacity to 50,000 tonnes.
He said Hoechst Trespaphan's expanded plant will supply its product to southeast Asian and Chinese markets.
